meta.title: Brandon Kamga · Software engineer
meta.description: Software engineer in Yaoundé, Cameroon: backend systems, platforms and DevOps. Founder of LesCracks.

about.title: About
about.statement: I build backend systems that hold up in production, and a community that pushes young people to innovate.
about.founderText: Articles, workshops, events and the LesCracks Talk.

steps.label: Domain first
steps.title: Business rules that depend on no framework.
steps.text: Hexagonal architecture and DDD on the backend: the domain is plain code, adapters plug in around it, and a test keeps the frameworks out.

steps.label: One command
steps.title: Every project starts with a single command.
steps.text: docker compose up, no configuration file to write. A new teammate runs the whole stack on day one.

steps.label: Shipped, not just coded
steps.title: Releases, migrations and health checks are part of the job.
steps.text: Versioned images, CI on every change, deploys that roll back with one click. Production is where the work counts.

steps.label: Bilingual by default
steps.title: Built for my region, in French and English.
steps.text: The products I build ship in both languages from the first commit, from the interface to the error messages.

projects.title: Selected work
projects.intro: Products I designed and built end to end, most of them in production.
